'''Patman Let Them Make The First Move/The Droids Will Have Their Revenge''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Patman]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FirstMove Patman DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

Saber Combat Deck that enjoys the many and sundry uses of battle droids. Can't wait for Theed Palace! (Droid Racks will be a _FUN_ addition to this deck)...

== Strategy ==

Unlike my LS Saber deck, this one has played a few games. Primary strategy tips:

*Set up a Dark Jedi at each starting Naboo site ASAP: enjoy those drains!

*Utilize the remaining characters to mess with opponent at each opportunity. With the droids, rifles, and Switch off/Self Destruct, the potential to avoid serious battle damage exists. Recycled sixes really make veins pop out in your opponent's forehead...

*Abyss is a life-saving card in my area! Avoiding multiple copies of unique cards in my own deck is tough, but the result is well-worth the effort. I have always managed to deal damage when using this card. "Are you SURE you want to pull all five destinies? Okay."

*A much higher-destiny deck than I am usually capable of. If your opponent races, a win for you is common.

Enjoy!
